entry.title: llama.cpp b12556 released
entry.summary: model : hrm : do not compute slot count as uint32_t ( #32601 ) load_arch_hparams multiplies n_hrm_layers_per_stack, n_hrm_h_cycles and (n_hrm_l_cycles + 1) into a uint32_t, then asserts the product equals block_count. Any factors whose true product is block_count + k*2^32 still pass the assert; 1073741825 * 2 * 2 = 2^3 — Also covered by: run-llama/llama_index
